descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S07 「短窗口 ±1 h（医院）：查房前和 Important Points 11 h / 13 h，已完成任务 15 h / 17 h，床旁和记录 17 h / 19 h」 Short windows ±1 h (Hospital): pre-round and Important Points 11 h / 13 h, completed task 15 h / 17 h, encounter and note 17 h / 19 h

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it.（UAT OAT-04 Expected 1；TFA-94699 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U2 Hospital pre-round text clears at 12 h: pre-round text seeded at 13 h is deleted.（UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: pre-round text 12 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U3 Hospital Important Points clear at 12 h: an Important Point seeded at 13 h is deleted.（UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: Important Points 12 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T4 Hospital completed tasks are deleted 16 h after they were completed.（TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: completed tasks 16 h)；UAT 3.6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 Hospital encounter dictation and note leave the working tabs at 18 h, are kept as yesterday's transcript / previous note until 36 h, and are then deleted.（TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: encounter, note)；UAT 3.6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Two synthetic Hospital patients aged by the aging helper: patient E at 11 h / 15 h / 17 h and patient L at 13 h / 17 h / 19 h, for pre-round text (since processed), an Important Point (since written), a completed task (since completed), and the day's encounter dictation and note (since recorded / generated)

When The purge runs; raw documents read with admin access

Then Patient E keeps every item. Patient L has no pre-round text, no Important Point and no completed task in the database; its encounter and note are off the working tabs and kept as yesterday's transcript and previous note

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 and the TFA-94699 table (12 h, 16 h, 18 h): present on the early side, absent on the late side (moved, not deleted, for the 19 h encounter and note) = pass; anything else = Fail. Tolerance around 'exactly' is Q1; the clock anchors are Q2 and Q3

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

写了 13 小时的 Important Point 还在预查房编辑器里；当天的笔记在 18 小时被清掉，而不是留作昨天的 previous note。

13 h after it was written an Important Point is still in the pre-round editor, and the day's note is wiped at 18 h instead of being kept as yesterday's previous note.

依据：allure 3ec704ca-…-result.json; retention lane. 20 checks pass, 4 fail, all known: K1 (L and W+1 min point) and K4 (the note is blanked at 18 h and never kept as a previous note).
